data.title: Left alone with nothing to do, AI agents started playing

content.basic: MIT researchers marooned 13 AIs on a virtual island, and they responded by inventing games, mourning a lost ring and, eventually, getting better at their jobs.

data.title: Uber rival inDrive eyes 2027 robotaxi tests in Central Asia with Pony.ai and Nvidia

content.basic: inDrive plans to begin testing Pony.ai's robotaxis in Kazakhstan's capital in the first half of 2027.
